transcript: Myself Kavindu, I am a recent computing graduate and I like mobile lab developer work. I know some flutter, firebase and rest APIs. I did customer support chatbot for customer service. better_answer_example: As a recent computing graduate with a passion for mobile lab development, I'm excited about the opportunity to work with ITN. In my previous project, I developed a customer support chatbot using Flutter, Firebase, and REST APIs. I was responsible for intent, flow design, and response testing. Although we faced challenges with wrong responses to similar questions, we overcame them through teamwork and perseverance. This experience not only taught me about mobile lab development but also the importance of collaboration and problem-solving. I believe my skills and experience align with this role, and I'm looking forward to contributing to ITN's team.
